zh_TW: 兩邊金幣不同，給新手或熟手一點差距。勝負改用「剩下的戰力占自己金幣的比例」來比，金幣少的一方不吃虧。
en: Give the sides different gold. Results compare remaining power as a share of each side's own gold, so the smaller army isn't penalised.

zh_TW: 讓子時紅方可以花的錢。
en: Red's gold when handicap is on.

zh_TW: 一邊最多擺幾隻。人越多畫面越擠、戰鬥越久；最多 40 隻。
en: Most units per side. More units means a busier screen and longer fights; up to 40.

zh_TW: 同一種兵最多幾隻。設低一點會逼你混編；太低時錢可能花不完，下面會提醒。

zh_TW: 戰鬥最長幾秒；時間到比剩下的戰力。狂熱會照比例提早或延後（一局的三分之二開始）。
en: Longest a fight can last; at time-out remaining power decides. Frenzy starts at two-thirds of the match.

zh_TW: 幾局決勝負。平手不算勝場；打到上限還沒分出來就比勝場。

zh_TW: 輪流落子：每人輪流擺、擺下不能收回，輪序公平。同時暗擺：各自擺好再一起翻開。

zh_TW: 自訂落子時每人輪幾手；每手的金額＝金幣上限÷手數。

zh_TW: 沒花完的錢留到下一手。可以先省後花，但對手也看得到你省了多少。

zh_TW: 簡單：隨意擺。普通：照常見陣型擺。困難：會讀你上一局的陣型來反制。
en: Easy: places loosely. Normal: uses common formations. Hard: reads your last formation and counters it.

zh_TW: 下一局一開始就是你上一局的陣型，只要微調。
en: Start each new round with your previous formation.

zh_TW: 關掉後可以在卡池分頁另外設定 AI 能用的兵。
en: Turn off to give the AI its own pool on the Unit pool tab.

zh_TW: 這局能用哪些兵，最多 10 種。至少要有 1 種戰鬥兵；支援兵和奇襲兵（孢子菇、爆爆羊、寶箱怪）都不算。

zh_TW: 把兵種的血量、攻擊、速度調成 50%～200%，或關掉技能。沙盒局不記戰績也不給成就。
en: Scale a unit's health, attack and speed from 50% to 200%, or turn skills off. Sandbox games don't count for stats or achievements.

zh_TW: 推薦的玩法：王國軍 10 種、100 金、三戰兩勝。數值經過完整驗收。
en: The recommended setup: 10 Kingdom units, 100 gold, best of 3. Fully balance-tested.

zh_TW: 只用最早的 5 種兵。規則最單純，雙人對戰唯一驗證過先後手公平的組合。
en: Only the first five units. The simplest game, and the only setup verified fair for two players.

zh_TW: 錢少、時間短，每一隻都要想清楚，一局一分鐘內結束。
en: Little gold and a short clock: every unit counts and a game is over in under a minute.

zh_TW: 180 金、最多 40 隻、120 秒。場面最熱鬧，戰鬥也最久。
en: 180 gold, up to 40 units, 120 seconds. The biggest, longest battles.

zh_TW: 只開一種戰鬥兵（可以再加一種支援兵），比的純粹是站位。到卡池分頁換兵種。
en: One fighter type (plus one support if you like): pure positioning. Change the type on the Unit pool tab.

zh_TW: 自訂規則。右邊列出和標準不同的地方。
en: Custom rules. The differences from standard are listed on the right.

zh_TW: 綁定正前方的敵人，受的傷分一半給對方
en: Binds the enemy straight ahead and passes it half the damage it takes

zh_TW: 每場一次：友軍殘血時定住周圍敵人，友軍減傷
en: Once per battle: when allies are hurt, freezes nearby enemies and shields allies

zh_TW: 後排法師，把友軍屍體變成骷髏；翻盤用
en: Back-line caster; raises fallen allies as skeletons to turn the tide

zh_TW: 把周圍所有敵人拉到自己身邊，和投彈兵、爆爆羊是搭檔
en: Pulls all nearby enemies to itself; pairs with bombers and Boom Sheep

zh_TW: 巨大又慢，拍地造成傷害並擊退；死後留下碎石減速區
en: Huge and slow; stomps deal damage and knock enemies back; leaves slowing rubble when it falls

zh_TW: 傭兵公會開張：奇幻軍 10 種全部上場。還在驗收中，屬於娛樂變體。
en: The guild is hiring: all 10 monster units fight. Still being balanced, so it counts as a fun variant.

zh_TW: 一局最多帶 10 種兵，先拿掉一種
en: You can bring at most 10 unit types. Remove one first.

zh_TW: 一局每邊最多 10 種兵
en: Each side can bring at most 10 unit types
You keep this army for the whole run

zh_TW: 這裡有地形擋著，換個位置
en: Terrain blocks this spot. Try another.

zh_TW: 地圖和大小只能配自由排兵
en: Maps and sizes need free placement.
The standard field with no terrain.

zh_TW: 中央是河，只能走兩座橋；箭和幽靈飛得過去
en: A river down the middle with two bridges. Arrows and ghosts cross freely.

zh_TW: 樹叢分出多條路，中間泥塘很慢
en: Trees split the field into paths, with a slow mud pond in the middle.

zh_TW: 中央冰面快、上下雪地慢，碎冰逼人繞路
en: Fast ice in the centre, slow snow on the edges, broken ice in the way.

zh_TW: 岩塊和熔岩分割戰場，中央灰燼很慢
en: Rocks and lava split the field, with slow ash in the centre.

zh_TW: 兩座大崖分三線：上下快而遠，中間慢而近
en: Two cliffs make three lanes: long and fast, or short and slow.

zh_TW: 固定地圖和對手，自己組牌。獲勝、戰力夠多、省錢，各一顆星。
en: Fixed map and foe; build your army. One star each for winning, power left, and thrift.

zh_TW: 挑戰碼已複製，傳給朋友
en: Challenge code copied. Send it to a friend.
No challenge code on the clipboard.

zh_TW: 之後每一戰的預算都加
之後每一戰的人數上限都加
目前累積：多 %d 金、多 %d 隻
en: So far: %d extra gold, %d more units

zh_TW: 不能再禁這張：卡池會不夠打
en: Can't ban that: not enough cards left to play.

zh_TW: 對手主力是%s。看看它怕誰（圖鑑有寫）
en: The enemy leans on %s. Check its weakness in the codex.

zh_TW: 這組牌有這個版本沒有的兵
en: That deck has units not in this version.

zh_TW: 對手傷害最高的是%s，克制它的有%s
en: %s dealt the most enemy damage. It is weak to %s.

zh_TW: 換戰場。平原以外的地圖有地形，算娛樂變體。
en: Choose the battlefield. Maps other than the plain have terrain and count as fun variants.

zh_TW: 換大小時會順便帶入建議的金幣、人數和時間，之後還能再調。
en: Changing size also sets suggested gold, unit limit and time; you can adjust them after.

zh_TW: 決定 AI 偏好哪些兵：鐵壁守前排、遠程放風箏、奇襲繞後、召喚拖長戰局。
en: Sets which units the AI favours: Wall holds the front, Ranged kites, Ambush flanks, Summoner drags the fight out.

zh_TW: 系列賽每局換不換地圖。換圖時不保留上一局陣型。
en: Whether the map changes each round. Changing maps clears your previous formation.

zh_TW: 開打前兩人輪流從卡池拿掉幾張。卡池太小時會自動少禁。
en: Before the match, players take turns removing cards. Small pools ban fewer automatically.

zh_TW: 這個系列的比分不會保留。
en: The score of this series will not be kept.

zh_TW: 遠征只在每戰之間存檔，這一戰不會保留。
en: Expeditions save between battles; this battle will not be kept.

zh_TW: 移動準星，按住 %s 畫出一排兵。先畫 4 隻以上。
en: Move the cursor and hold %s to draw a line of units. Draw at least 4.

zh_TW: 把準星移到擺好的兵上，按住 %s 就能搬到別的位置。
en: Put the cursor on a placed unit and hold %s to move it somewhere else.

zh_TW: 擺好了就按 %s 開戰。一開戰就不能再動，敵軍這時才會現身。
en: Press %s when you're ready. Once the battle starts nothing can move, and the enemy appears.

zh_TW: 上次打到第 %d 戰，要接著打嗎？
en: You reached battle %d last time. Continue?

zh_TW: 對手只剩 %d%% 戰力。改一隻兵試試？
en: The enemy has only %d%% power left. Try changing one unit?

zh_TW: 先複製朋友給的代碼，再按下面的按鈕。
en: Copy the code from your friend first, then press a button below.
This is in the full version.

zh_TW: 地形圖沒有平衡認證；AI 對戰裡奇幻軍在這裡勝率較低。
en: Terrain maps are not balance-certified; the Fantasy army wins less often here in AI battles.

zh_TW: 全隊獲得最大血量 %d%% 的護盾，持續 %d 秒。傷害先扣護盾。
en: The whole team gets a shield worth %d%% of max HP for %d s. Damage hits the shield first.

zh_TW: 全隊攻擊速度 +%d%%，持續 %d 秒。
en: The whole team attacks %d%% faster for %d s.

zh_TW: 全隊立刻回復最大血量的 %d%%。
en: The whole team instantly heals %d%% of max HP.

zh_TW: 砸向敵人最密集的地方，範圍內每隻受到 %d 傷害。
en: Strikes the densest enemy group, dealing %d damage to each unit in range.
All enemies are stunned for %s s.

zh_TW: 開啟後，戰鬥中可以按按鈕施放（鍵盤 1、2、3）。AI 也會用。屬於娛樂規則，不算平衡認證。
en: When on, press a button during battle to cast (keys 1, 2, 3). The AI uses them too. This is a fun rule, not balance-certified.

zh_TW: 至少要帶 1 種；不想用就關掉手動技能
en: Keep at least 1; turn manual skills off to use none

zh_TW: 戰鬥中自己決定什麼時候放全隊技能。一邊帶 1～3 種，點卡片帶或不帶。雙人時藍方按 1、2、3，紅方按 8、9、0。
en: Choose when to fire team-wide skills during battle. Bring 1 to 3 per side; click a card to toggle. In duels Blue uses 1, 2, 3 and Red uses 8, 9, 0.

zh_TW: 每一種技能一場能放幾次。
en: How many times each skill can be used per battle.

zh_TW: 同一種技能放完要等多久才能再放。
en: How long before the same skill can be used again.

zh_TW: 護盾量、回血量、傷害、定身時間的倍率。
en: Scales shield amount, healing, damage and stun time.

zh_TW: 過關一次（拿到 1 星）後解鎖：三星解用了哪些兵、幾隻。
en: Clear it once (1★) to see which units the three-star answer uses.

zh_TW: 會把三星解直接擺上去，你自己的擺法會被換掉。確定嗎？
en: This places the three-star answer on the board and replaces your setup. Sure?

zh_TW: 已擺上三星解，按開戰看看。
en: Three-star answer placed. Hit Start to watch.

zh_TW: 手把：L3 提示　R3 時間
